verdict.rationale: Aleph's Scan AI analyst is documented to run flux and variance analysis and produce "clear commentary on what changed and why it matters." It lets users set materiality thresholds, suggests drill-down dimensions such as vendor, and reports when it finds nothing notable instead of hallucinating. It also claims board-ready variance analysis alongside versioned forecasts. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that budget-to-actual variances (as opposed to period-over-period flux) are explained, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of commentary quality.
